# Vendored pico-examples files

Source repository: https://github.com/raspberrypi/pico-examples

Upstream commit: `c81c855ffdedc825975a40ba357723a71358ddf0`

Original paths:

- `pico_w/wifi/access_point/dhcpserver/dhcpserver.c`
- `pico_w/wifi/access_point/dhcpserver/dhcpserver.h`
- `pico_w/wifi/access_point/dnsserver/dnsserver.c`
- `pico_w/wifi/access_point/dnsserver/dnsserver.h`

The files are copied without local source changes. The DHCP server files are
derived from MicroPython and retain their MIT notices. The DNS server files
retain Raspberry Pi's BSD-3-Clause/SPDX notices.

To check for upstream updates, compare these four paths against the recorded
commit before replacing the vendored copies and updating this file.
